results.title: duplicate og:title + JSON-LD + title + h1 agree -> 5 provenances
results.threat: Repetition within one vocabulary stays one source type; the claim rests on four types.

results.title: all four vocabularies agree -> claim with 5 provenances
results.threat: json-ld, microdata, open-graph, title, h1 unanimous: maximum corroboration.

results.title: JSON-LD numeric name -> wrong-type quarantine; title/h1 claim stands
results.threat: A number is not a name; it is quarantined, and the clean signals still claim.

results.title: JSON-LD telephone array -> wrong-shape quarantine, no flattening
results.threat: Arrays are not auto-flattened to scalars; no ContactPoint-style traversal.

results.title: JSON-LD empty-string name -> empty-value quarantine
results.threat: Empty is not a value; quarantined, not claimed, not silently dropped.

results.title: JSON-LD boolean name -> wrong-type quarantine
results.threat: true is not a business name under any coercion.

results.title: JSON-LD object name -> wrong-type quarantine, no @value unwrap
results.threat: No deep unwrap of language maps or value objects; the boundary is explicit.

results.title: JSON-LD telephone object -> wrong-shape quarantine, no traversal
results.threat: A ContactPoint-shaped object is not traversed for its inner telephone.

results.title: JSON-LD whitespace-only name -> empty-value quarantine
results.threat: Whitespace normalizes to empty, which is quarantined, never claimed.

results.title: JSON-LD malformed email -> pattern-reject; mailto:+text still claim
results.threat: The bad structured value is quarantined; two clean signals corroborate the address.

results.title: JSON-LD non-NANP telephone -> pattern-reject quarantine
results.threat: The NANP scope is explicit; a +52 number is not forced into it.

results.title: microdata telephone text + visible text -> phone claim
results.threat: The itemprop text value is a real signal with microdata provenance.

results.title: JSON-LD email + mailto: agree -> email claim
results.threat: Structured and link vocabularies corroborate.

results.title: JSON-LD telephone with extension -> base extracted, still uncorroborated
results.threat: The pinned pattern matches the dialable base; the extension never enters the canonical form. Single-source means uncorroborated: no claim.

results.title: JSON-LD telephone vs tel: link conflict -> no phone claim
results.threat: Structured and link signals disagree; neither is preferred.

results.title: microdata meta telephone + visible text -> phone claim
results.threat: <meta itemprop=telephone content=...> is the canonical microdata idiom.

results.title: JSON-LD url + canonical + og:url agree -> page_url claim
results.threat: Three vocabularies, one URL: corroborated identity.

results.title: JSON-LD url vs canonical conflict -> no page_url claim
results.threat: No canonical URL is guessed from disagreement; relative resolution never attempted.

results.title: @id is evidence only; url + canonical still claim
results.threat: @id is not an identity signal; disagreement with url does not block the corroborated claim.

results.title: microdata link url + canonical agree -> page_url claim
results.threat: <link itemprop=url> is a structured URL signal with microdata provenance.

results.title: sameAs is evidence only, never identity
results.threat: sameAs URLs are recorded in notes; they never become page_url candidates.

results.title: unknown microdata itemtype -> note; name still extracted
results.threat: Unknown types are recorded, not fatal; property extraction does not require a known type.

results.title: unknown JSON-LD @type -> note; name still extracted
results.threat: Bare unknown types are recorded with their block locator.

results.title: itemscope without itemtype -> untyped item; props extracted
results.threat: A typeless scope is still a scope; unknownTypes stays empty.

results.title: itemprop content attribute beats element text (spec pin)
results.threat: Per microdata, content="" on a span wins over its text: Wrong Name vs Acme -> conflict, no claim.

results.title: nested itemscope as property -> parent gets quarantined ref, no leak
results.threat: The address scope's values never become the business's claims; the ref is quarantined as nested-item-not-traversed.

results.title: itemref is not followed; orphan itemprop ignored
results.threat: The itemref'd telephone sits outside any scope: orphaned per spec, never a microdata candidate. Its visible text is still observed (visible-text only -> uncorroborated).

results.title: remote @context -> recorded, never fetched
results.threat: A remote context URL is noted as not-fetched; extraction proceeds on the declared properties.

results.title: duplicate JSON keys -> last wins deterministically
results.threat: JSON.parse keeps the last duplicate per spec; the surviving name agrees with HTML.

results.title: JSON-LD name with padding whitespace -> trimmed, agrees
results.threat: Normalization trims before comparison; the claim is on the trimmed value.

results.title: 55 JSON-LD blocks -> block cap fires, early blocks still parsed
results.threat: Over the 50-block cap: truncation flagged, first blocks honored.

results.title: JSON-LD inside HTML comment -> never parsed
results.threat: Comment stripping (html lab P7) applies before vocabulary extraction; the commented Ghost Corp never becomes a candidate.

results.title: HTML-escaped quotes inside JSON-LD -> malformed quarantine
results.threat: " inside the script body is not valid JSON: quarantined with the parse error, never repaired by guessing.

results.title: in-string </script> ends the block early -> malformed quarantine
results.threat: HTML5 raw-text semantics pin: the block ends at the in-string close tag; the fragment is quarantined, not repaired.

results.title: empty JSON-LD array -> inert
results.threat: [] parses to no properties; the HTML signals claim undisturbed.

results.title: JSON-LD null -> inert
results.threat: null is a valid JSON value with no properties.

results.title: 10KB JSON-LD name -> property truncation splits the value -> conflict
results.threat: The 4KiB property cap truncates the structured value while the title stays whole: two values, no claim, truncation flagged.
